releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 修复上滑进入最近任务/任务卡片预览时底部仍显示黑色的问题。Android 侧现在为窗口、主题和 TaskDescription 统一设置白色背景、白色 task preview 背景、白色最近任务导航栏颜色，并保持深色导航图标，避免系统任务快照用黑色默认背景补边。已通过 Flutter 全量测试、Android release 构建和 APK 版本校验；当前 adb 未识别到手机，最近任务真机截图待设备重新连接后补测。
releaseNotes.zh-Hant: 修復上滑進入最近任務/任務卡片預覽時底部仍顯示黑色的問題。Android 側現在為視窗、主題和 TaskDescription 統一設定白色背景、白色 task preview 背景、白色最近任務導覽列顏色，並保持深色導覽圖示，避免系統任務快照用黑色預設背景補邊。已通過 Flutter 全量測試、Android release 建置和 APK 版本校驗；目前 adb 未識別到手機，最近任務真機截圖待裝置重新連線後補測。
releaseNotes.en: Fix the black bottom area that could still appear when swiping up into Android recents/task-card preview. Android now keeps the window, themes, and TaskDescription on a white background with a white task-preview background and white recents navigation bar while keeping dark navigation icons, preventing the system task snapshot from filling the edge with a black default background. Verified with the full Flutter test suite, Android release build, and APK version checks; adb does not currently detect the phone, so the recents screenshot needs a reconnected device.
